name: Harry Mason
source:
Harrold "Harry" Mason is one of the three protagonists of the game and the adoptive father of Cheryl. When Cheryl goes missing in the hellish town of Silent Hill, he takes it upon himself to rescue her.

[From [url=https://silenthill.fandom.com/wiki/Harry_Mason]Silent Hill Wiki[/url]]
